reviews.review:
Great game!

Fixes a lot of Q.O.L. issues from the 4.1 game, such as online enemy balancing/scaling issues, pickup rates, the leveling and loot gain (or lack thereof) of unplayed classes, pacing, etc.

I have a few hundred hours in mainline EDFs, between 2017, 2025, 4.1 and now 5.  I have about 1500 hours logged in Insect Armageddon, and a good 70 in Iron Rain, I just picked it up and its awesome(not on the deck tho, Iron Rain crashed my deck a few dozen times at least.  

Funny, I love EDF.  Especially, Insect Armageddon, which all EDF fans s**t all over and I'm tired of it because it's better than this.  They both have ridiculous stories, they both require a grind, they both have pretty much the same quality of cheezy voicework.  Insect Armageddon tho, is fair.  EDF 5 is the same as all the other ones, which is great but no better than EDF IA that tried something different, and influenced the rest of the series.  

Everyone says EDFIA is too short; EDF5 has way too many levels, could have gotten away with half as many. 
Everyone says EDFIA didn't have enough enemy types.  EDF5 doesn't have many more, just more pallet swaps.  What EDFIA does not have, is "I stopped running, so now I slide defenselessly for 3 seconds, while a red ant grabs me."  Or the getting thrown across the map, and still taking damage as you get up!  I feel like an enemy in castle crashers, getting juggled across the map! The onscreen mess is just unnecessary at this point, we've seen it in 2017, 2025, 4.1, 5...  Fix it.  It does not add to the game.   I am tired of giant carcasses blocking my shot, and not being able to see, anything.  Its great for 1 of the EDFs, but as a fan, do what EDF IA did, let them instantly dissolve so I can see what I'm doing.  And enough with the spider webbing, I thought throwing vehicles was waaay cooler.  Someone somewhere complained about EDFIA status effects...  Sorry EDF5 has way worse, with Spider webbing, a blinding amount of ant acid, and the red ants are just no fun.  They are awful.  Like, take them out of this game, worse than 2017, c'mon man this is Bulls**t!!!  

Love me this game, you already have your mind made up on get it or not, but stop picking on both Insect Armageddon and Iron Rain.  They were great, and in so many ways better than 2017, 2025, 4.1, 5, and I'm assuming the difference between 6 and the rest is like comparing Maddens, FIFAs, or CODs.  Same, same, same, only minor changes but no real improvement.

Fencer is a pain to move without Dash 3 equipped but so worth the time investment. I absolutely love the way it decimates entire crowds and has a variety of play styles available. My favorite loadout combo is shield/gatling and big cannon/hand cannon. This is the future Elon expects. Send help. --with love, a amerkin
